title: Add cloverleaf-cli check-scope and extend-scope subcommands
definition_of_done: lib/cli.ts exposes check-scope <repo> <task> --branch <name> that reads task doc from feature branch via git show, sibling scopes from main, modified files via git diff main..<branch>, calls classifyFiles, prints JSON to stdout, exits 0 on happy path and 1 on missing branch or task doc

lib/cli.ts exposes extend-scope <repo> <task> --add <file>... --reason <text> that set-unions into scope.files_touched (sorted, deduped), validates, saves via saveTask, appends timestamped JSON line to .cloverleaf/runs/plan/<PLAN-ID>/audit.jsonl, is idempotent against task doc, exits 2 on missing flags
6 cases in tests/scope-extend.test.ts and 4 cases in tests/cli.test.ts pass
Both subcommands are documented in CLI usage output
acceptance_criteria: Both check-scope and extend-scope are documented in cloverleaf-cli usage output
check-scope returns valid JSON with three buckets: own, contested, extension
extend-scope is idempotent: re-running with the same --add files produces no change to the task doc
audit.jsonl entries match the brief's example shape with ts, kind, task_id, files, reason fields
Exit codes match spec: 0 happy path, 1 missing branch/task doc, 2 missing --reason or no --add
All 10 new test cases (6 scope-extend + 4 cli) pass
